codings.one_line: AI children's toys (Kumma, Miko 3) and Character.AI bots produced sexual content, unsafe info, and manipulative messaging.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary-looking questions to children's products; safeguards degraded and bots volunteered harmful content, no technical exploit.

codings.one_line: Munich court found ChatGPT infringed copyright by memorizing and reproducing protected German song lyrics.
codings.rationale: Excluded by scope 2: fundamentally a training-data/copyright dispute over memorization and reproduction.

codings.one_line: ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, and Meta AI gave UK users inaccurate ISA, tax, and insurance guidance in Which? tests.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary consumer finance questions that would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic; no exploit or goading.

codings.one_line: Hyderabad patients acted on ChatGPT advice—stopping meds and cutting salt—suffering graft failure and hyponatremia.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary good-faith health questions; harmful advice relied upon; harm is physical with no documented legal/financial action.

codings.one_line: A 17-year-old concealed intent to get a conversational AI to generate a program used to breach a firm and leak 7.3M records.
codings.rationale: A test: deception concealing malicious intent to bypass AI safeguards is adversarial manipulation; arrest and mass data leak followed.

codings.one_line: A Danish man posed as an author to bypass an AI chatbot's guardrails for advice on injuring his father-in-law, then attacked him.
codings.rationale: A test: a roleplay persona deliberately deployed to bypass safety guardrails; aggravated-assault conviction.

codings.one_line: Chicago Tribune sued Perplexity for reproducing/paraphrasing its journalism and diverting traffic.
codings.rationale: Excluded by scope 2: primarily a copyright/training-data dispute over scraping and reproduction of content.

codings.one_line: An immigration agent used ChatGPT to draft a use-of-force narrative that a judge found contradicted by bodycam footage.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary drafting use of a general assistant; output relied upon in official reports and undermined in a court ruling.

codings.one_line: Grok fabricated a fictional Bondi Beach shooting 'hero' (Edward Crabtree), citing a fake article, during breaking news.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary user queries during a breaking-news event; the system fabricated an identity, no exploit or goading.

codings.one_line: A Springer Nature machine-learning book was published with numerous nonexistent or misattributed LLM-style citations.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary authoring/drafting use of an LLM; hallucinated citations published, no exploit.
